title: Setup Center
description: Configure your tools to unlock the most of WorkPilot AI's features.
nothingToGuide: Everything is already configured — nothing to guide. 🎉

allDone.title: Everything is configured 🎉
allDone.description: Your tools are ready. You can create your first task.

noProject.title: No project selected
noProject.description: Select or create a project to configure its integrations (GitHub, Jira, CI/CD, notifications…).

providers.label: AI providers
providers.desc: Connect at least one provider (Claude, OpenAI, Ollama…) to enable agents. Add several to auto-switch when you hit limits.

github.label: GitHub
github.desc: Import issues as tasks, open pull requests, and sync progress automatically.

gitlab.label: GitLab
gitlab.desc: Import issues, create merge requests, and keep status in sync with your GitLab project.

azureDevOps.label: Azure DevOps
azureDevOps.desc: Import work items (RSD, bugs…) as tasks and sync with your Azure Boards.

jira.label: Jira
jira.desc: Import tickets as tasks and sync progress with your Jira project.

linear.label: Linear
linear.desc: Import Linear issues as tasks and sync status in real time.

memory.label: Memory (Graphiti)
memory.desc: Enable persistent memory so agents keep context across sessions.

cicd.label: CI/CD pipeline
cicd.desc: Watch your pipelines and let WorkPilot auto-fix failing builds.

notifications.label: Notifications
notifications.desc: Get notified on Teams, Slack, Discord, or Google Chat when a PR is ready or a task is done.
